lifecycles.name: Patient to Discharge
lifecycles.description: Patient access, clinical triage, inpatient care delivery, and safe discharge transitions.

lifecycles.name: Revenue Cycle Management
lifecycles.description: Clinical charge capture, medical coding, electronic claim transmission, remittance, and cash reconciliation.

raci_definitions.role_attending_physician: Accountable for clinical order execution, diagnostic decisions, and discharge disposition.
raci_definitions.role_triage_nurse: Responsible for clinical intake, vital sign assessment, and bedside care execution.
raci_definitions.role_patient_access_specialist: Responsible for demographic registration, eligibility verification, and upfront patient collections.
raci_definitions.role_medical_coder: Responsible for ICD-10 and CPT coding compliance and charge review.
raci_definitions.role_rcm_director: Accountable for revenue cycle performance, denial management, and accounts receivable reconciliation.
raci_definitions.role_compliance_officer: Accountable for HIPAA privacy, regulatory compliance, and billing integrity.
raci_definitions.role_patient: Informed participant in clinical care transitions, treatment plans, and guarantor for patient balances.
